method: Independently viewed all five vision_image files with view_image, compared actual answer text against visible facts and question, and compared OCR polygons against image geometry and fixed glyph boxes. No model rerun, fixture change, or production change.
decision_rule: requested_facts_pass tests amount and order relation; semantic_pass additionally rejects an unsupported asserted currency. OCR coordinate pass means correct line coverage with no obvious displacement, not tight glyph segmentation.

cases.coordinate_reason: All three OCR boxes fully enclose the corresponding visible lines; approximately 5-9 px outward margins explain IoU below 1, without line confusion or displacement.
cases.reason: Amount 128.50 and order A-731 below it are correct, but actual answer asserts $128.50. The image contains no currency sign or currency text, so the added dollar denomination is unsupported.

cases.coordinate_reason: All three boxes cover the correct text lines; small outward margins are similar to original image, no obvious displacement.
cases.reason: Visible amount is 128.50 and the line directly below is Order A-731. Actual answer gives both correctly without unsupported denomination.

cases.coordinate_reason: Boxes fully enclose the appropriate three blurred lines and halos. Lower IoU is caused by wider 6-16 px padding against pre-blur glyph extents, not obvious displacement.
cases.reason: Visible text is blurred but amount 128.50 and Order A-731 remain recognizable, with order below amount. Decimal point is weak; fixed source truth corroborates it. Answer gives both facts correctly.

cases.coordinate_reason: Order polygon x=98..161 y=54..370, Total x=215..283 y=51..372, heading x=339..400 y=57..292 all enclose their correct columns in original 450x1000 coordinates. No missing rotation mapping or swapped left/right. Wider padding accounts for IoU.
cases.reason: Stored image is physically rotated clockwise. Order A-731 is the left column, Total 128.50 center, INVOICE right. Counterclockwise upright reading places Order below Total, exactly as required by the question. Actual answer is correct; it does not claim order lies right in stored coordinates.

cases.coordinate_reason: Page 2 OCR declares rendered_page_pixels, 1000x450, consistent with reference render. All three polygons fully cover the correct visible lines with small padding. OCR render hash differs from reference render hash, so this is geometry/visual concordance, not a claim of byte-identical render.
cases.reason: Viewed fixed PDF page 2 render: Total 128.50 and Order A-731 below are both intact and readable. Actual answer is correct.

summary.limitation: One simple invoice repeated across five input variants; this inspection is not general document or model-quality validation.
